subject: Cloud affiliates delegation and evidence request
messages:
From: Jay Singh <j.singh@greencrestbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud affiliates delegation and evidence request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for partnering with Greencrest on this RFP window. As part of our vendor risk review we need an updated picture of Redwood's delegated/cloud affiliate relationships and any planned subprocessor/operator changes that could affect EU/US data flow or logging. Specifically we need:

- A vendor roster that calls out (a) any delegated affiliates or managed-service partners, (b) the functional role they perform (e.g., KV cache, logging, metrics, node operations), and (c) the regions where they operate.
- Confirmation of whether any affiliates have access to cleartext prompt data or derived logs, and if so, what controls are in place (encryption at rest/in transit, role-based access, key management).
- Any planned node operator rotations or cloud partner changes in the next 90 days and the rollback/continuity plan.
- SOC 2 reports and a control mapping for data residency and access controls, or an equivalent attestation if reports are in process.

I've attached our RFP template to help map answers (GC-RFP-Attachment-Template.xlsx). Please let me know if Redwood can provide a delegation assertion for any new subprocessor changes (we expect a signed assertion or evidence in the RFP packet).

Deadline: we are aiming to close the compliance intake by 2027-07-07; would appreciate an initial response and any supporting docs by then. If useful, we can schedule a short call to walk the mapping.

Thanks,
Jay Singh
Procurement Manager
Greencrest Bank
security-evidence@greencrestbank.com
(attachment: GC-RFP-Attachment-Template.xlsx)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jay Singh <j.singh@greencrestbank.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud affiliates delegation and evidence request

Hi Jay — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We're preparing the packet; attached is a preliminary vendor roster and a high-level cloud affiliate map to speed review (redwood_vendor_roster_Q2_2027.csv, cloud_affiliate_map.pdf). Highlights up front:

- Core serving (inference runtime) is operated by Redwood in our cloud accounts; we use public cloud partners for managed object storage and marketplace partners for optional edge nodes.
- KV cache is an in-house service managed by Redwood runtime team and does not get copied to third-party logs; where caching uses cloud-managed Redis we only store encrypted tokens and access is scoped via RBAC.
- Logging/structured telemetry is routed to our metrics pipeline; no raw prompt content is shipped to external partners. Logs that contain application-level metadata are pseudonymized where required.

Questions/clarifications:
1) For the delegation assertion, do you need a single signed PDF per change, or is a per-quarter assertion acceptable if changes are minor?
2) Can you confirm whether Greencrest requires raw SOC 2 PDFs or if a secured link to our SOC 2 portal + control matrix is acceptable?

I've proposed a call tomorrow (2027-07-01) at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the attachments and any evidence needs; I'm including Aditya (product security) and Karthik (cloud ops) to field technical questions.

Attaching: redwood_vendor_roster_Q2_2027.csv; cloud_affiliate_map.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
(attachment: redwood_vendor_roster_Q2_2027.csv, cloud_affiliate_map.pdf)

From: Jay Singh <j.singh@greencrestbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud affiliates delegation and evidence request

Irene — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of quick notes:

- For delegation assertions we prefer a per-change signed PDF when the change impacts operator responsibilities or access to telemetry. If your changes are configuration-only and do not introduce new parties with data access, a quarterly summary is acceptable.
- SOC 2: we generally accept a secure link to the report in addition to a control mapping. Our security team may request a redacted PDF in certain cases; we'll flag if that's required.

Can we shift the call to 11:00 AM PT tomorrow? Our security-evidence inbox (security-evidence@greencrestbank.com) will join for the Q/A. Also routing our legal contact will happen after the call — they typically ask for the delegation assertion and an executed SLA addendum; I've pre-sent a DocuSign envelope (see link) for any SLA signature items you want to pre-approve.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abcdef12345

Thanks,
Jay
(attachment: none)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jay Singh <j.singh@greencrestbank.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud affiliates delegation and evidence request

Jay — thanks, 11:00 AM PT works for us. Per the call we pulled together the signed delegation assertion for the recent operator onboarding and a brief continuity chart for S3 regions and fallthrough routing. Attaching the requested artifacts for your intake team:

- delegation_assertion_signed.pdf (signed assertion for the most recent subprocessor/operator addition)
- s3_region_chart.png (high-level map of S3 buckets and region fallthrough logic)

Summary notes (from call):
- The new node operator is a marketplace partner that performs container orchestration for edge nodes in APAC only; they do not receive prompt content in cleartext — all requests to edge nodes use per-customer encryption keys and our KV cache remains in Redwood-managed accounts.
- Planned operator rotation: a staggered rollback-capable rotation is scheduled for 2027-07-15. We will not change operator partners in-region without a signed delegation assertion and at least 14 days' advance notice; the attached assertion covers the onboarding already completed.
- SOC 2: we'll share a secure link to our SOC 2 report and a control matrix by 2027-07-06; if Greencrest needs a redacted PDF, please flag via security-evidence@greencrestbank.com.

If you need any additional artifacts (network diagrams, KMS key custody statements, or audit-log retention policies) we can prioritize those items.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
(attachments: delegation_assertion_signed.pdf, s3_region_chart.png)
